about: Decisions for the Cosplay room and the Fanart split. cosplay.py reads this file. Every photo under media/layla-and-fanny/art/cosplay must be listed in photos or left_out, or the script stops.
rules: Cosplay is shown only where the post is identified and credited (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md, item 16).
No minors. A clip of a real person whose post the sources do not identify stays out.
The photos keep the keys they already have in the mirror (fanart/cosplay-*). Nothing is copied or re-encoded for them.
search: Every picture of the sources was looked at on contact sheets: the 807 different files outside _all (the 12 photos below aside) and the 1024 different pictures of _all. Video frames and GIFs were seen only as the thumbnails and footage stills the folders hold. The 12 photos below are the only cosplay photos in the sources. The captions index (media/_captions) names only three cosplay posts: CYtQu1bsHd_, CYv1hKbJHuL and CYym3VEMobd.

posts.CYtQu1bsHd_: first reveal, 14 Jan 2022, Fanny and Layla together
